summary: Trinseo PLC filed a Form 8-K on September 30, 2026, reporting a previously adjourned 2026 Annual General Meeting and an Extraordinary General Meeting, both delayed from September 23, 2026, for lack of quorum. At the adjourned AGM, 491,031 shares present constituted a quorum under Article 88, and shareholders elected eleven directors, approved executive compensation on an advisory basis, and ratified PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor. The AGM was further adjourned to a date to be determined. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or deal terms are stated; this is a routine shareholder-meeting report, not a special situation.
